backup.production_rule: One live function is replaced: health_checks_core_v1, which both the dashboard's System health button and the nightly verifier call. The body was not retyped: a script cut it from 20260921020000_health_checks_core.sql, asserted the cut hashes to the live md5(prosrc) f169d017fa1a9a9d768dd495d7219caf (read 2026-09-23), then applied five exact one-hit replacements. The first forward check asserts the resulting md5. No table, row or grant changes. Backup is the last act before the apply (D-210, D-217.6).

forward_verification.name: the_core_body_is_the_reviewed_body
forward_verification.query: select md5(p.prosrc) = 'f54b5cb4dde2ccc2d223ae5ace8d16f3' from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid = p.pronamespace where n.nspname = 'public' and p.proname = 'health_checks_core_v1'

forward_verification.name: the_three_money_checks_read_the_accounting_start
forward_verification.query: select p.prosrc like '%acct_settings s where s.property_id = p_property_id%' and p.prosrc like '%x.checkout_date >= v_start%' and p.prosrc like '%r.checkout_date >= v_start%' and p.prosrc like '%transaction_date >= v_start%' and p.prosrc like '%p.opening + p.net < 0%' from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid = p.pronamespace where n.nspname = 'public' and p.proname = 'health_checks_core_v1'

forward_verification.name: the_core_is_still_reachable_only_through_a_wrapper
forward_verification.query: select not has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.health_checks_core_v1(uuid, boolean)', 'EXECUTE') and not has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.health_checks_core_v1(uuid, boolean)', 'EXECUTE') and has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.run_health_checks_v1(uuid)', 'EXECUTE') and has_function_privilege('service_role', 'public.run_health_checks_service_v1(uuid)', 'EXECUTE')

forward_verification.name: the_accounting_start_the_checks_read_is_on_record
forward_verification.query: select accounting_start = '2026-09-01' from public.acct_settings where property_id = '6ae230f4-c189-4547-84b1-cb6e0b2cc9bd'

feature_flags.name: next_health_run_rewrites_three_findings
feature_flags.required_state: The next daily verifier run refreshes the health checks: completed_stays_paid, payout_totals_agree and ledger_position turn pass on production data (read 2026-09-23: 0 unpaid stays since 2026-09-01, 26,259.85 = 26,259.85, position 7,704.52 >= 0), so their V10 findings resolve by themselves.

compatibility.rehearsal: Rehearsed 2026-09-23T01:2xZ on a disposable restore of cascade-supabase-20260923T011328Z (taken for the rehearsal, after release verifier_triage_and_opening_amounts_20260923; 0 leftovers). 102 tables, 120 ledger rows before; migration applied 1/1; forward 4/4; pgTAP money_checks_from_accounting_start.sql 7/7, verifier_triage_and_opening_amounts.sql 22/22, health_checks_core_v10.sql 26/27 - the one miss is its grant assertion, which a --no-acl restore cannot carry and which CI ran green. Two suite bugs found by rehearsing and fixed: the core returns {ranAt, checks}, and trg_reservation_reconcile creates a payout row for any completed stay with host_payout, so fixtures leave it null.
compatibility.evidence: Same function signature, same return shape, same keys. ledger_position's detail gains opening and since; net now carries the position (opening + income - expenses - drawings since the start), which is what the digest and the verifier card print. pgTAP money_checks_from_accounting_start.sql: a fires/silent pair per re-scoped check.
